notes.title: DEV LOG #1
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, fellow adventurers![/b]

It's been an exhilarating journey since our last update, and we're thrilled to share the latest developments in the world of Just Get There!. The past few weeks have been a whirlwind of creativity and hard work as we dove headfirst into the magical process of game development.

[b]New Level Unveiled: The Castle of Wonders
[/b]
The highlight of our recent endeavors has been the creation of a new level - none other than the majestic Castle of Wonders. Picture this: towering spires scraping the heavens, intricate bridges connecting distant towers, mind-bending mazes that will challenge even the most seasoned players, and imposing walls that echo with the secrets of a bygone era.

Until next time, brave souls!
